senses.def: A type of entity in X-bar theory, denoting the verb in a constructed sentence.

An exploit in which the VBA (Visual Basic for Applications) source code in a document is removed or replaced, but the compiled p-code is left intact. Since in some cases only the source code is checked for malware, this can allow malicious code to go undetected.
A vaginal birth undertaken with precautionary measures subsequent to a cesarean section birth.
ex: I was worried about having a VBAC because my mother nearly bled to death when she gave live birth to me after having had a cesarean.
